text:
maya: Postmortem follow-up — after yesterday's outage we agreed we need tighter rollout controls (auto-rollback, blast-radius tagging, canary sampling). Quick sync: owners + timelines? I'll start a checklist.

zack: Short list: 1) auto-rollback policy and prototype, 2) flag metadata for blast-radius, 3) canary alerting + runbook. Also add 'max ramp without approval' enforcement.

maya: Assigning owners: zack -> auto-rollback prototype (target 2025-03-14), priya -> flag metadata + UI tags (target 2025-03-07), kevin -> dashboard alert + runbook (target 2025-03-10), jordan -> rollout policy enforcement (sampling caps).

priya: Ack. I'll add schema PR for flag metadata, migrate existing flags, and update Console tag UI. Need ~3d for backend + 1d frontend. I'll request QA after PR.

kevin: I'll adapt the existing alert: `canary_error_rate > 3% for 5m` -> page #eng-oncall and link to rollback playbook. Will author runbook with steps + rollback command examples.

jordan: Suggest adding `max_canary_percent` in rollout config and block auto-ramp >50% without owner signoff. I'll own the policy enforcement changes.

oncall-bot: Created follow-up ticket RF-432 in 'incident-followups' board: https://ourboard.company/boards/RF-432 :white_check_mark:

maya: Good. Also we should run a 'recurring pattern' review: weekly check-ins for first 6 weeks post-rollout + monthly incident-pattern review for 6 months. Who can own the cadence?

zack: I'll run the weekly 30m sync for the next 6 weeks and add calendar invites. I'll post short notes each week to the RF-432 thread.

priya: Can someone put a simple action-status template on the ticket board? Columns: To Do / In Progress / Blocked / Ready for QA / Done. QA owner field would help.

maya: Done — added template to RF-432 and mirrored in the postmortem doc: https://docs.company/pm/1856001234

kevin: I'll open the alert + runbook PR by Thu. If I hit infra limits (metric cardinality), I'll flag here.

zack: I'll spike `feature/auto-rollback-prototype` branch, include an end-to-end demo and basic unit tests. If this needs infra changes I will loop eng-infra.

maya: Next steps: owners create PRs/tasks by EOD Monday. If blockers, ping @maya directly. We'll follow up in the first weekly sync.

zack: ACK. :thumbsup:

priya: ACK — starting schema PR tomorrow.

kevin: ACK.

maya: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
